passages.text: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.
The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Be still, and know that I am God.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.
Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases; his mercies never come to an end.
Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.
Be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, as God in Christ forgave you.
So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you.
Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.
Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself.
But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles.
I sought the Lord, and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.
Cast your cares on the Lord and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous be shaken.
Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.
May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him.
For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love and self-discipline.
Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or terrified, for the Lord your God goes with you.
The Lord is good, a refuge in times of trouble. He cares for those who trust in him.
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; when you pass through the rivers, they will not sweep over you.
And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.
Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace.
If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.
Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you.
The Lord is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear?
Pray, and let God worry.
passages.author: Martin Luther

passages.text: Faith is a living, daring confidence in God's grace.
passages.author: Martin Luther

passages.text: Everything that is done in the world is done by hope.
passages.author: Martin Luther

passages.text: You can't go back and change the beginning, but you can start where you are and change the ending.
passages.author: C.S. Lewis

passages.text: Humility is not thinking less of yourself, it's thinking of yourself less.
passages.author: C.S. Lewis

passages.text: God whispers to us in our pleasures, speaks in our conscience, but shouts in our pains.
passages.author: C.S. Lewis

passages.text: There are far, far better things ahead than any we leave behind.
passages.author: C.S. Lewis

passages.text: Courage is contagious. When a brave man takes a stand, the spines of others are often stiffened.
passages.author: Billy Graham

passages.text: God has given us two hands—one to receive with and the other to give with.
passages.author: Billy Graham

passages.text: When we come to the end of ourselves, we come to the beginning of God.
passages.author: Billy Graham

passages.text: Let gratitude be the pillow upon which you kneel to say your nightly prayer.
passages.author: Maya Angelou

passages.text: Faith does not eliminate questions. But faith knows where to take them.
passages.author: Elisabeth Elliot

passages.text: The Christian life is not a constant high. I have my moments of deep discouragement.
passages.author: Elisabeth Elliot
